capabilities: Enter a modal tab-editing mode on a staff
Write frets, slides and bends from the keyboard
Select, copy, paste, repeat and delete measures
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later; the plugin sets no hotkeys of its own. The author states it was written with Claude Code and not reviewed line by line.
problem: Hand-editing plain-text tab staves is error-prone, because every beat must be three characters wide and bars must line up across all rows.
summary: Keyboard-driven editor for guitar and bass tablature kept as plain text in fenced code blocks.
